INDUSTRY PERFORMANCE

The 12 services industries reporting growth in June are: Accommodation & Food Services; Administrative & Support Services; Construction; Finance & Insurance; Health Care & Social Assistance; Management of Companies & Support Services; Mining; Professional, Scientific & Technical Services; Public Administration; Real Estate, Rental & Leasing; Retail Trade; and Wholesale Trade.
